purpose: Independent check that volatile logger flags are reread between original tests, not snapshotted once.

synthetic_mutation.note: Code-hook mutation is a synthetic observer test; it does not claim an actual concurrent writer exists.

evidence.source_macro: FLAGS expands to a volatile uint8_t load at 0x20004543 at every use.
evidence.source_elf: Distinct LDRB instructions at 0x10048, 0x10050, 0x10060 (replacement probe); repeated checks occur at 0x1009e, 0x100a8, 0x100b0 after publication.
